Welcome to The Webinar Vet's channel!

Our videos cover all sorts of topics within the veterinary community, including top tips, discussions on the latest news, webinar previews and more! Be sure to stick around and you might even recognise some special guests from the profession joining Anthony Chadwick on the channel!

The Webinar Vet is a  veterinary education webinar service, we educate vets in the comfort of their own home! With the LARGEST veterinary community in the world, we offer premium online veterinary CPD, with over 1,500 webinars available and over 70,00 members! 

If you'd like to continue your veterinary learning, then find the right membership for you here: https://www.thewebinarvet.com/membership

Don't forget to Subscribe and we'll see you on a video!
